name: What areas does Frasheski Construction serve for tile and surface updates?

mainEntity.name: What areas does Frasheski Construction serve for tile and surface updates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction primarily serves the Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito areas for tile and surface updates. We are familiar with the specific architectural styles and building requirements within these communities. If you are located slightly outside these areas, please contact us to discuss your project; we may be able to accommodate your needs.
